supplemental_render.note: 400 dpi review rendering of the official p.38 page; v0.47 reviewed #6, v0.48 reviewed #7, and v0.49 reviewed #8 connectivity and its schematic/parts-list value conflict. This is a derivative of the same published schematic and parts list.

terminal_conventions.loop_3: loop_a is the upper end of the drawn loop connected to the 7A8 signal-input conductor; loop_b is the opposite/lower lead and remains unassigned pending the #2 winding crosswalk. No winding polarity is implied.
terminal_conventions.tuning_capacitor_4: rf_stator is the RF-gang terminal drawn on the signal-input conductor; rotor is the grounded terminal for loop operation. osc_stator remains unassigned in this trace.
terminal_conventions.aerial_compensator_5: a is the upper terminal on the signal-input conductor and b is the grounded terminal; no polarity is implied.
terminal_conventions.tube_v1: The factory symbol signal-input grid is mapped to socket terminal V1:6 using the reviewed 7A8 pin-role reference; the adjacent symbol-level source path is followed without inferring the other 7A8 electrode wires.
terminal_conventions.component_6: cap_a is the upper #6 condenser lead on F_RF_INPUT; cap_b and choke_a form the drawn internal series junction; choke_b ends at the explicit loop-operation chassis ground. No B− equivalence or RF behavior is inferred.
terminal_conventions.component_7: 7:a is the upper 4.7 MΩ resistor lead at the lower loop/#2 11-turn winding junction; 7:b is the lower lead on B−. This establishes external connectivity only.
terminal_conventions.component_8: a and b are drawing-end aliases only: #8:a is the upper loop/#2 11-turn junction; #8:b is B−. The source value is disputed between schematic and parts list.

verified_endpoints.interpretation: The 7A8 signal-input grid G4 lead joins the upper built-in-loop terminal and RF tuning input node.
Upper built-in-loop terminal joins the 7A8 signal-input grid and RF tuning input node.
RF gang upper terminal is drawn on the common signal-input conductor.
Upper aerial-compensator terminal joins the same RF input conductor.
The RF gang grounded terminal is tied to the explicit chassis ground symbol for loop operation.
The opposite aerial-compensator terminal is tied to the explicit chassis ground symbol for loop operation.
The upper terminal of the #6 2 mmf condenser joins the 7A8 RF signal-input conductor.
The lower condenser terminal connects directly to the upper terminal of the #6 series choke.
The upper choke terminal connects directly to the lower terminal of the #6 series condenser.

verified_endpoints.joined_factory_member: explicit chassis ground reference for loop operation
verified_endpoints.interpretation: The lower #6 choke terminal ends at the explicit ground symbol; Philco identifies grounds as chassis for loop operation. It is not mapped to B−.
Upper #7 4.7 MΩ terminal joins the lower built-in-loop lead and the upper end of the #2 11-turn winding.
Lower #7 4.7 MΩ terminal joins the same B− rail as the lower #2 11-turn winding terminal.
Upper #8 capacitor terminal is drawn on the lower-loop/#2 11-turn winding junction shared with the upper #7 resistor terminal. The terminal alias is not polarity.
Lower #8 capacitor terminal is drawn on the B− rail shared with the lower #2 11-turn winding and lower #7 resistor terminals. The terminal alias is not polarity.
